name: Quality-Status Artifact Governance Closure
description: Connect programming-artifact quality-status records, quality export snapshots, and prompt artifact quality evaluation so artifact prompt extraction can distinguish synthetic context from verified governance closure evidence. Adjacent operational-ontology registry allocation documents are explicitly out of scope unless this feature starts registering ontology packs into registry-service/index-meta allocation lifecycle.

userStories.title: Detect quality-status records during artifact extraction
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want extract-artifact to recognize related quality-status records so that artifact prompt context can use actual quality evidence instead of only synthetic governance runs.
acceptanceCriteria: extract-artifact --artifact-registry <file> discovers quality-status records that verify or materialize the requested artifact, definition, or work area
Matching uses existing fields only: kind, verifiesRefs, materializesOutputRefs, sourceRefs, outputPath, and relations
Registry hit behavior remains backward compatible for direct artifact record lookup
Registry miss, file fallback, definition fallback, and search fallback behavior remain unchanged except for additional governance evidence when related quality records are found
JSON output includes a structured summary of matched quality-status records

userStories.title: Load quality export JSON as governance closure evidence
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want quality-status records with outputPath to load their exported JSON snapshot so that prompt quality can reason over real bundle and gate status.
acceptanceCriteria: When a matched quality-status record has an existing outputPath, the CLI loads the JSON snapshot safely
Invalid or missing JSON does not crash extraction and produces a structured warning in JSON output
Loaded snapshot evidence includes root id, bundle ids, bundle state, verified gate counts, total gate counts, claim counts, and generated timestamp when present
Snapshot-derived evidence is added to prompt extraction source metadata or governance evidence without breaking existing public artifact shapes
Tests cover a valid quality export file and a missing or invalid quality export file warning path

userStories.title: Reflect quality-status evidence in prompt quality evaluation
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want prompt artifact quality evaluation to improve governance closure when quality-status evidence exists so that managed verified artifacts score better than unmanaged synthetic artifacts.
acceptanceCriteria: Prompt quality evaluation can receive quality-status evidence from artifact extraction
governance_closure improves when quality-status evidence verifies the target and reports verified bundles or gates
quality-status evidence that reports failed, stale, invalid, or incomplete verification emits a governance warning instead of silently improving the score
Existing quality behavior for non-artifact prompt extraction remains backward compatible
Unit tests cover ready, usable, and degraded outcomes with and without quality-status evidence

userStories.title: Enrich quality export registry records for closure
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want quality export --artifact-registry records to include enough metadata for governance closure so that later prompt extraction can consume them without guessing.
acceptanceCriteria: quality export --artifact-registry records include metadata summarizing bundle states, verified gate counts, total gate counts, claim counts, and generated timestamp
verifiesRefs includes the root id and bundle ids
materializesOutputRefs includes the root quality system id
verificationRefs remains populated with bundle ids or relevant verification refs available from the snapshot
Existing registry JSON shape stays compatible with current provider reads
Tests verify the enriched metadata shape

userStories.title: Surface governance closure status in extract-artifact JSON
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want extract-artifact --json to show whether governance closure came from quality-status evidence so that agents and humans can see why a prompt artifact is ready, usable, or degraded.
acceptanceCriteria: JSON output includes a governanceClosure or equivalent structured object
The governance closure object distinguishes quality-status-found, quality-status-missing, quality-status-invalid, and quality-status-incomplete
The governance closure object lists matched quality-status artifact refs
The governance closure object includes warning and action data when closure is incomplete
Search fallback quality warning remains separate from governance closure warning
